description: Search and filter OunceScout's canonical gold, silver, platinum, palladium, and copper bullion catalog (coins, bars, rounds). THE buyer tool: use it for cheapest-price, lowest-premium, product and 'where can I buy' questions. Each result carries the lowest verified price AND its delivered total (deliveredPriceUsd), premium over spot (lowestPremiumOverSpotPct), the winning dealer, price checked-at + age, and the top-3 dealer offers with delivered prices (topOffers) — comparison evidence is included here, no second call needed. If a search returns 0 products, the server automatically retries with matchedOnly relaxed and known synonyms expanded (see relaxedFilters); a truly empty result returns nearestMatches and a next step instead of a dead end.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (1 to 25, default 10).

matchedOnly.description: If true, return only products with multiple compared dealers.

metal.description: Optional metal filter. Any other value is an error naming the allowed values — never a silent empty result.

q.description: Alias for 'search' (accepted for compatibility with clients that send q).

search.description: Optional search keyword (e.g., 'American Eagle', 'Maple Leaf', '10 oz silver bar', 'Krugerrand').

name: search_bullion_catalog
